title: Pattern Recognized as a 2026 Inc. Power Partner Award Winner for the Fifth Consecutive Year
summary: Pattern Group Inc. (Nasdaq: PTRN) (“Pattern”), a leader in accelerating brands on global ecommerce marketplaces, has been named a 2026 Inc. body_markdown:
**LEHI, Utah, October 21, 2026 —** Pattern Group Inc. (Nasdaq: PTRN) (“Pattern”), a leader in accelerating brands on global ecommerce marketplaces, has been named a 2026 Inc. Power Partner Awards winner, its fifth consecutive year receiving the honor. The award recognizes the company among the leading B2B partners supporting entrepreneurs and businesses across the country.


“Being named an Inc. Power Partner five years in a row is a credit to the brands who trust us to help them grow and the team that shows up for them every day,” said Dave Wright, Co-Founder and CEO of Pattern. “When our brands win, we win. This year we launched Pattern Intelligence, which puts more than a decade of data to work and acts on opportunities for our brand partners around the clock. We’re grateful to Inc. and, most of all, to our brand partners.”


The annual Inc. Power Partner Awards honor B2B companies that have demonstrated a track record of helping entrepreneurs and businesses navigate the challenges of building and growing a company. From hiring and compliance to technology, infrastructure, fundraising, marketing, and more, these partners provide expertise and services that enable businesses to operate, scale, and pursue their ambitions.


“Business owners have no shortage of tools at their disposal, and B2B companies need to make clear why their products and services are worth the investment,” says Bonny Ghosh, editorial director at Inc. “The companies on this year’s Power Partners list have done just that. They don’t just have customers — they have superfans and evangelists. Across industries like marketing, financial services, and technology, they’ve proved their dedication to helping fellow business owners grow and succeed.”


Pattern was recognized for its continued investment in technology and for results delivered to brand partners across more than 70 global marketplaces. In May 2026, Pattern launched Pattern Intelligence (Pi), an AI-powered autonomous ecommerce execution engine that runs active sensors across featured offers, advertising, content, pricing, and inventory, and takes automated action when opportunities or issues arise.


**About Pattern**


Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 91 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across more than 70 global marketplaces—including Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, JD, and Mercado Libre.
